record.original_question: Let K be a semiring and let a K-weighted automaton compute a function τ: A* → K by summing, for each input word, the outputs of all successful paths with that label. Decide whether the behaviour τ of a given weighted automaton has finite range.

evidence.quote: The function τ : A∗ → K realized by A is defined as follows. Given a word u ∈ A∗, τ(u) is the sum of the outputs of all successful paths of label u.
Problem 3 Decide whether or not the behaviour of a given weighted automaton has a finite range.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a semiring and let $A$ be a finite alphabet. A $K$-weighted automaton over $A$ consists of a finite set of states $Q$, an initial weighting $I : Q \to K$, a final weighting $F : Q \to K$, and a transition weighting $E : Q \times A \times Q \to K$. For a word $u = a_1 a_2 \cdots a_n \in A^*$, a path of label $u$ is a sequence $q_0 \xrightarrow{a_1} q_1 \xrightarrow{a_2} \cdots \xrightarrow{a_n} q_n$, and its output is $I(q_0)\, E(q_0,a_1,q_1)\, E(q_1,a_2,q_2)\cdots E(q_{n-1},a_n,q_n)\, F(q_n)$. The behaviour realised by the automaton is the function $\tau : A^* \to K$ assigning to each word $u$ the sum (in $K$) of the outputs of all paths of label $u$.

Provide an algorithm that, given as input a $K$-weighted automaton (for a suitably specified semiring $K$), decides whether its behaviour $\tau$ has finite range, i.e. whether the set $\{\tau(u) : u \in A^*\} \subseteq K$ is finite; or show that no such algorithm exists. Determine for which semirings $K$ this problem is decidable.
artifact.status_search_result: The decidability of the finite-range (finite-image) problem for weighted automata depends on the underlying semiring. Recent work establishes decidability for suitable weighted automata over past-finite monotonic strong bimonoids, while also showing undecidability for deterministic weighted automata over certain idempotent commutative past-finite ordered semirings and for general weighted automata over certain commutative past-finite monotonic ordered strong bimonoids. The general problem, posed for arbitrary semirings, remains open in many cases (e.g., the rationals or tropical semiring depending on ambiguity).

status_evidence.title: Decidability Boundaries for the Finite-Image Property of Weighted Finite Automata
status_evidence.snippet: undecidability results concerning the finite-image property of weighted finite automata over semirings and strong bimonoids
status_evidence.claim: The finite-image (finite-range) problem is undecidable for several natural classes of ordered semirings and strong bimonoids, while decidable for past-finite monotonic strong bimonoids.

status_evidence.title: What's decidable about weighted automata?
status_evidence.snippet: fundamental problems solved decades ago for Boolean automata are still open or undecidable in the weighted setting
status_evidence.claim: Many natural decision problems for weighted automata, including range-related questions, remain open or are known to be undecidable depending on the semiring.
